registry.description: Prefix for first-party images, e.g. ghcr.io/acme/

rateLimits.description: Rate-limit overrides by policy name (kebab or camel case) → WEBFLIX_RATE_LIMIT_<POLICY>

additionalProperties.description: limit/windowSec, or empty for the default

databaseTimeouts.description: PostgreSQL budgets per role in ms → WEBFLIX_DATABASE_<ROLE>_{STATEMENT,QUERY}_TIMEOUT_MS

queryMs.description: client-side bound on an answer; must exceed statementMs (0: none)
client-side bound on an answer; must exceed statementMs (0: none)
client-side bound on an answer; must exceed statementMs (0: none)

databaseKeepAliveMs.description: TCP keepalive first probe on database connections (ms; 0 off; null: 10000)

generateWithoutCluster.description: Allow generating credentials when rendering without cluster access (throwaway renders only)

appExistingSecret.description: Secret with WEBFLIX_PSEUDONYM_KEY (and outside production WEBFLIX_DEV_IDP_SECRET, WEBFLIX_PAYMENTS_FAKE_WEBHOOK_SECRET); empty: generated and kept

envFrom.description: Secrets whose keys become environment variables (provider credentials)

manifest.description: blob:<key> in the bucket, or empty for none

clientCertSecret.description: kubernetes.io/tls Secret for mutual TLS, mounted at /etc/webflix/tls/database

tcpKeepalive.description: net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl / _probes for API, worker and Job pods; null for none

to.description: NetworkPolicyPeer list; empty = any destination on port 53

lake.description: Serialize the lake-rewriting jobs in one CronJob (stores without conditional writes, such as Garage)

pipeline.description: The recommendation pipeline's and the privacy jobs' CronJobs (services/recs)

mailcatcher.description: Mailpit: catches what the SMTP sender sends (local clusters)
